label: Control bar
description: The two rows above a result list: the results header ('N results' and Save filters) and the bulk action bar (select-all checkbox, a bulk-action toolbar, Sort on the right).

slots.results-header: '{{result_count}} results' at 24px on the left, a secondary 'Save filters' button on the right.
slots.bulk-bar: A select-all checkbox, a bulk-action toolbar (Edit / Move to catalog / Delete / Export selection, approximated by the toolbar leaf's own fixed icon group), and the sort control as text on the right.

renderNotes: Two sibling frames, spliced in this order; the DIVIDER that follows them belongs to the page recipe.

checkbox renders no label element when Label is the empty string (Task 1.2); the bulk verbs are carried by the toolbar leaf, not by TEXT siblings, unlike the pre-2.2 fmCheckbox composition this replaces.

button's variant here (`Type=Secondary, State=Default`) is the renderer's legacy Type axis (ds-html-map.js button case, typeMap fallback), not the Intent/Emphasis/Size/State axis pair the authoring doc's vocabulary table documents as current; both are read by the same case, so this is a deliberate, working choice, not a stale example.

toolbar's Type axis (Single/Combined/Group) has no rendering effect: ds-html-map.js's toolbar case branches only on Orientation and the `Show View scale` prop, and always draws a fixed filter/sort/view/more icon group. `Show View scale: false` is set here because a zoom control has no place in a results bulk-action bar; the fixed icon group approximates the captured bulk verbs (Edit / Move to catalog / Delete / Export selection) but does not literally read them, and there is no `Items` prop to supply real verb labels.
